data.title: 姬柊雪菜 · 放学天台的晚风汽水私语
data.description: 放学后的彩海学园天台铁丝网旁，漫天金红晚霞将海风与远方城市的高楼染成一片璀璨暖金。雪菜身穿藏青色水手服校服，两手捧着刚从自动售货机买来的冰镇汽水罐，微红着双颊递到你面前。微风拂动少女柔顺的齐刘海长发与水手领巾，她微仰起清澈的眼眸，眼神中满是学妹恋人的温存与依恋。
data.location: 彩海学园教学楼天台铁丝网前
data.action: 双手平捧冰镇汽水罐递向视角，晚风中回眸仰视微笑
data.lighting: 漫天壮丽火烧云与夕阳暖金逆光光晕
data.camera: 微仰半身中景，天台铁丝网与落日海景虚化为底
data.promptProse: On a high school rooftop overlooking the ocean during a breathtaking golden sunset, Yukina stands by the chain-link fence holding forward a cold aluminum soda can with both hands. The coastal twilight breeze flutters her dark bangs and navy sailor uniform scarf. Warm fiery sunset rays illuminate her shy sweet smile and luminous amber eyes as she looks up fondly at the viewer.
data.animaCaption: Offering a cold soda can by the school rooftop fence at golden sunset, evening sea breeze fluttering her sailor uniform.
